en.headline: Airport Authority signs MoU for Tuen Mun sustainable aviation fuel blending facility
en.dek: The agreement with Towngas and EcoCeres advances discussions on a local blending plant to help meet the 2030 target for greener jet fuel.
body: The Airport Authority signed a memorandum of understanding on Tuesday with the Hong Kong and China Gas Company (Towngas) and EcoCeres to develop a sustainable aviation fuel blending facility in Tuen Mun.

The signing took place during the Asian Logistics, Maritime and Aviation Conference and was witnessed by Chief Executive John Lee, Transport and Logistics Secretary Mable Chan, Airport Authority chief executive Vivian Cheung and Towngas chairman Peter Lee. The document was signed by Airport Authority chief operating officer Steven Yiu, Towngas executive director Alan Chan and EcoCeres chief executive Matti Lievonen.

Under the MoU the three parties will continue discussions on the design, construction and operation of the facility. Implementation remains subject to terms still to be agreed. The Airport Authority said existing fuel infrastructure at the airport can already receive, store and uplift pre-blended sustainable aviation fuel, and that one local airline has already done so.

The government has set a target for sustainable aviation fuel to account for one to three percent of fuel used by flights departing Hong Kong International Airport by 2030. Lee previously said in his Policy Address that the government would take forward a blending facility to build an end-to-end value chain and reduce logistics costs.

zh.headline: 機管局與煤氣公司及怡斯萊簽備忘錄 磋商屯門建可持續航空燃料混合設施
zh.dek: 三方同意繼續討論設計、興建及營運事宜，配合政府2030年可持續航空燃料使用目標。
body: 機場管理局周二與香港中華煤氣有限公司及怡斯萊簽署諒解備忘錄，同意就於屯門設計、興建及營運一座可持續航空燃料混合設施繼續磋商。
簽署儀式於亞洲物流航運及空運會議期間舉行，由行政長官李家超、運輸及物流局局長陳美寶、機管局行政總裁張李佳蕙及煤氣公司主席李家傑見證。備忘錄由機管局營運總監姚兆中、煤氣公司執行董事陳英龍及怡斯萊行政總裁Matti Lievonen簽署。
機管局表示，本港機場現有燃油基礎設施已具備接收、儲存及讓航空公司加注預先混合可持續航空燃料的能力，其中一家本地航空公司已成功加注。項目落實詳情將視乎三方日後同意的條款而定。
政府目標是到2030年，可持續航空燃料佔香港國際機場出發航班燃油的一至三個百分點。李家超較早前在施政報告中宣布，政府將推動在香港興建混合設施，構建完整價值鏈並降低物流成本。
